common-ground-church-fredericksburg.assessment: Common Ground Church has a compelling origin story: 21 years as a mobile congregation finally receiving a permanent home — the historic First Christian Church building on Washington Ave, gifted free of charge by a 100-year-old congregation choosing to bless its successor. That kind of kingdom generosity, and CG's decision to then give their former meeting house (The Old Silk Mill space) to a Filipino congregation, shows genuine missional health. Lead Pastor Gregg Jennings trained at Gordon-Conwell Theological Seminary (among the most rigorous conservative evangelical seminaries), studied both Theology and Global Missions, and has pastored CG since 2009. The church has elders, active ministries including a men's night, kids, and youth programs. Main yellow flags: Melissa Southall holds a staff pastoral title and was ordained in 2021 (female ordained pastor in a worship/outreach role); the inclusive table language may reflect a broad-welcome posture or a softer ecclesiology — worth hearing a sermon and asking Gregg directly about his complementarian convictions and Scripture inerrancy. Overall a promising, established community church worth visiting.

connection-church-buda.assessment: The Connection Church in Buda, TX is a GREEN-rated multi-campus church led by Pastor Cole Phillips (D.Min, Southwestern Baptist). Theologically robust: strong inerrancy, substitutionary atonement, eternal security, complementary gender roles, biblical marriage (one man/one woman), sanctity of life. C3 Global network provides real denominational accountability. "Men of Steel" men's ministry meets 1st & 3rd Saturdays at 8 AM — Proverbs 27:17 iron-sharpens-iron discipleship. Dudeman (Moop's brother) attends regularly and serves on the worship team. Moop has attended personally. One of the strongest church finds in the Austin/San Marcos corridor.

score_notes.christology: Explicitly affirms Jesus Christ as Son of God, co-equal with Father, sinless life, substitutionary atonement, bodily resurrection, second coming as King of Kings.
score_notes.scripture: Bible is God's Word, written under supernatural guidance of Holy Spirit, supreme source of truth, inspired by God, truth without any mixture of error. Strong inerrancy position.
score_notes.gender: Statement of faith explicitly affirms God creates each person as male or female, two distinct complementary genders. Biblical marriage = one man + one woman. Male lead pastor (Cole Phillips). Green.
score_notes.leadership: Male lead pastor Cole Phillips (D.Min, SWBTS). C3 Global network provides apostolic covering and external accountability. Multi-campus model with strong organizational structure. Green.
score_notes.soteriology: Salvation by grace through faith alone, not by works. Eternal security affirmed — maintained by grace and power of God, not self-effort. Reformed soteriology.
score_notes.cultural: Strong pro-life stance. Biblical gender/sexuality position. No DEI or social justice language. Sanctity of human life from conception to natural death explicitly stated. | MOOP-relationship note (Adam Johns 2026-04-29): Adam's brother "Dudeman" attends here. Adam's 2026-04-29 message references "The Connection Church in San Marcos TX" — possible discrepancy with this Buda record. Verify whether brother attends Buda or San Marcos (different campus or different church?).
score_notes.preaching: Pastor Cole Phillips trained at Southwestern Baptist Theological Seminary — one of the top conservative SBC seminaries. Statement of faith is theologically robust. Moop has attended personally and can confirm teaching quality. Green.
score_notes.mission: Active multi-campus growth, community outreach, new campus development. Mission-oriented.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Men of Steel — dedicated men's ministry meeting 1st and 3rd Saturdays at 8:00 AM at the Buda campus. Proverbs 27:17 ("As iron sharpens iron, so one man sharpens another") is the guiding verse. Monthly gatherings for Scripture application, personal accountability, sharing struggles and victories, mentorship. Dudeman (Moop's brother) attends regularly. This is real, intentional men's formation. Green.
score_notes.denominational: C3 Global (Christian City Church) — international church network providing real denominational accountability and apostolic covering. Not independent. Green.

cornerstone-baptist-church-brooklyn-ny.assessment: Cornerstone Baptist Church at 574 Madison Street in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn, is the lifelong home church of House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries (D-NY-8). Jeffries grew up in Crown Heights and was formed at Cornerstone — in his youth becoming one of the church's white-gloved, dues-paying ushers, tending to crying babies and handling neighborhood traffic during worship. Cornerstone is institutionally part of the National Baptist Convention USA, the largest historically Black Baptist denomination. Rev. Lawrence E. Aker III is current senior pastor. NBC-USA is generally evangelical-Baptist on core doctrine but specific posture on sexuality, women in pastoral ministry, and biblical inerrancy varies by congregation. Per MOOP rubric this is YELLOW — would need on-site verification of confessional posture and pulpit theology before a recommendation; included with notable-attendees context for the most prominent Democratic House leader.

cornerstone-chapel-apostolic.assessment: Cornerstone Chapel is an Apostolic/Oneness Pentecostal church — and that's a hard stop for theological alignment. Oneness Pentecostalism denies the eternal distinction of the three persons of the Trinity (Father, Son, Holy Spirit), teaching instead that 'Jesus' is the only name of God and the three are merely different modes. This places it outside the bounds of Nicene orthodoxy — the same line historic Christianity drew in 325 AD. Additionally, most Apostolic churches teach that speaking in tongues and baptism in 'Jesus' name only' are necessary for salvation, adding works to justification. The congregation may be sincere and passionate, but the core theological framework disqualifies it for anyone committed to trinitarian Christianity and faith-alone soteriology. Not recommended.

score_notes.soteriology: Oneness Pentecostal tradition typically requires Acts 2:38 formula (Jesus-name baptism + tongues) for salvation — sacramental regeneration per rubric = red.

cornerstone-chapel-leesburg.assessment: Cornerstone Chapel under Gary Hamrick is one of the strongest Bible-teaching churches in Northern Virginia. Founded in 1991 with 18 charter members, Hamrick has grown it into a thriving congregation through verse-by-verse exposition through every book of the Bible — the Calvary Chapel way. His Wednesday night teaching is particularly notable: a mid-week deep dive that many men would find more satisfying than a typical Sunday service. 30+ years of consistent, doctrinally sound, culturally clear pastoral leadership is rare and valuable. covenant-bible-church-georgetown.assessment: Covenant Bible Church is a Reformed Baptist congregation in North Georgetown (Austin metro area) planted and led by pastor-theologian Joel Webbon. The church affirms the 1689 Second London Baptist Confession — one of the most rigorous and historically grounded confessions in Protestant Christianity — placing it firmly within the Reformed, biblical-patriarchy, and expository preaching tradition. Webbon is a nationally known voice through Right Response Ministries, openly advocating biblical patriarchy (he explicitly rejects the 'complementarian' label) and Christian Nationalism. He has headlined panels on biblical patriarchy alongside Doug Wilson, Eric Conn, and Dale Partridge, and the church is networked with Church & Family Life (Scott Brown). He has generated controversy for some of his political/cultural commentary — men should evaluate this directly rather than through secondhand coverage. The church's theological foundation is solid: Trinitarian, faith-alone soteriology, male eldership, expository preaching, and Great Commission focus. The one caution is independence — no formal denominational structure means accountability rests on the internal elder structure. For men in the Georgetown/Austin area seeking a doctrinally serious, unapologetically patriarchal church, this is worth a visit. Personal note: Connected to Joel Webb (Webbon) referenced in USMC Ministries network.

score_notes.scripture: 1689 LBCF affirms the divine inspiration, infallibility, and supreme authority of Scripture. Green.

covenant-life-church-gaithersburg.assessment: Covenant Life Church has an extraordinary and complicated history. Founded in 1977 by C.J. Mahaney as a charismatic fellowship, it evolved into one of America's most theologically sophisticated Reformed evangelical churches — hosting conferences, producing discipleship resources, and nurturing a generation of serious Bible-saturated Christians. But CLC also became ground zero for significant controversies: the Sovereign Grace Churches abuse lawsuit (2012), C.J. Mahaney's leadership scandals, and most publicly — Joshua Harris (pastor 2004-2015) publicly deconstructing his faith in 2019 and renouncing Christianity. Current pastor Mark Mitchell leads a congregation that has weathered enormous institutional trauma. The theological framework (Reformed, complementarian, Gospel-centered) remains intact on paper. The questions are about institutional health, pastoral culture, and whether the congregation has genuinely processed and healed from years of controversy. Worth visiting with eyes wide open.

score_notes.leadership: Current Lead Pastor is Kevin Rogers (not Mark Mitchell as in prior enrichment). Staff pastors also include Robin Boisvert (Adult), Todd Keeler (Student Life), Philip Martin (Adult), Jamie Leach (Covenant Life School); non-staff pastors Pat Ennis, John Leconte, Jose Troche, Dave Calderone, Roddy Aguirre, Frank Fuentes. All male — confirmed complementarian pastoral team. Plurality of elders is transparent — upgrading leadership to green.

covenant-methodist-dothan-al-gmc.assessment: Covenant Methodist Church of Dothan, Alabama was founded in 1979 by Pastor B. Michael Watson and joined the Global Methodist Church on May 8, 2023. covenant-opc-brighton-mi.assessment: Covenant Orthodox Presbyterian Church is a congregation of the Orthodox Presbyterian Church (OPC), the confessional Reformed denomination founded in 1936 by J. Gresham Machen. OPC churches subscribe to the Westminster Confession of Faith and Catechisms, restrict ordained office to qualified men, and practice presbyterian polity with accountability through session, presbytery, and General Assembly. Baseline green rating reflects confessional identity; verify local particulars on the website.

score_notes.christology: OPC subscribes to the Westminster Standards — orthodox Trinitarian Christology, Chalcedonian two-natures, virgin birth, bodily resurrection.
score_notes.scripture: Westminster Confession ch. 1 affirms plenary verbal inspiration and inerrancy of the Scriptures as the only rule of faith and life.
score_notes.gender: OPC Book of Church Order restricts the offices of teaching elder, ruling elder, and deacon to qualified men only (1 Tim 2–3; Titus 1).
score_notes.leadership: Plurality of ordained male elders (session) under presbyterian polity with accountability to the presbytery and General Assembly.
score_notes.soteriology: Reformed soteriology per Westminster — monergistic regeneration, sola fide, sola gratia, sola Scriptura, effectual calling, perseverance of the saints.
score_notes.cultural: OPC historically resists theological accommodation to cultural pressure — Machen's legacy of confessional fidelity over cultural relevance.
score_notes.denominational: Orthodox Presbyterian Church — founded 1936 by J. Gresham Machen as a confessionally Reformed denomination against Modernism in the PCUSA.
score_notes.preaching: OPC pulpits are characterized by expository, Christ-centered, Law/Gospel preaching from the Westminster tradition.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: OPC congregations typically emphasize family worship, catechism instruction, and male headship in home and church — strong formation pipeline for men.
score_notes.mission: OPC Committee on Foreign Missions and Home Missions actively plants confessionally Reformed churches domestically and abroad.

covenant-presbyterian-harrisonburg.assessment: Covenant Presbyterian Church Harrisonburg is a PCA congregation under the Blue Ridge Presbytery — arguably the gold standard for Reformed evangelical accountability in American denominational life. The Westminster Confession of Faith provides the most rigorous doctrinal framework of any evangelical denomination. Rev. Todd Pruitt is a known Reformed voice who brings theological seriousness to pastoral ministry. Two full morning services (8:30 AM and 11:15 AM) signal a congregation of meaningful size with the infrastructure to support solid men's, children's, and discipleship ministries. The James Madison University context (Harrisonburg is a college town) gives Covenant opportunities for campus ministry and young adult outreach alongside its established membership. For a man in Harrisonburg or the Shenandoah Valley wanting the strongest Reformed confessional accountability available, Covenant Presbyterian is the benchmark.
